biggest_catch: You must buy a new, large (over 4.4 cu. ft.) all-in-one washer + heat-pump dryer combo, install it at your ComEd service address, and apply within 60 days of purchase — and you cannot stack this with any other ComEd efficiency offer.
catches: The combo unit must be over 4.4 cubic feet and new — used or refurbished products do not qualify.
Purchase must be made by December 31, 2026; apply within 60 days of purchase or by February 28, 2027, whichever comes first.
Illinois purchase/use tax rules apply; most products must be ENERGY STAR certified.
Cannot be combined with any other ComEd energy-efficiency offer on the same equipment.
The $350 is a mail-in rebate requiring a qualifying purchase — a purchase condition, not an upfront fee.

steps: Buy a new all-in-one washer + heat-pump dryer over 4.4 cu. ft. (most models must be ENERGY STAR) by December 31, 2026.
Install it at your ComEd service address and keep the itemized sales receipt.
Complete the official ComEd 2026 appliance rebate application and submit it within 60 days of purchase (or by February 28, 2027, whichever is earlier).
Wait for approval; your $350 rebate check arrives approximately four weeks after approval.
